meta.description: Named private and wheeled projects observed from trade press, NOT loaded into any derived file. A holding queue to be reconciled against the next Power Futures Lab IPP monitor, expected February 2027, which replaces by_source.private wholesale.
meta.why_a_queue: Rule 5: when a new edition of a source lands, replace the whole block and re-derive rather than adding the delta. Press reports cannot be added to by_source.private without breaking that, and would also break identity 3 unless FIXED.pvUtilityMW moves with them - and what that constant represents is currently unknown. So these wait here, named, rather than being lost.
meta.on_arrival: When the H2 2026 monitor lands: replace by_source.private from it, then check each entry below against the monitor. An entry the monitor already carries is DELETED from this file, not added anywhere. An entry the monitor omits is a question for Power Futures Lab, not a licence to hand-edit.
meta.effect_when_loaded: These megawatts are NOT missing from the model. NTCSA's weekly privately-procured solar PV total covers all non-REIPPPP, non-RMIPPPP solar - wheeled and behind-the-meter alike - and FIXED.rooftopMW is derived from it by subtracting the wheeled plant in by_source.private, which currently covers H1 2026 only. So every entry below is already inside rooftopMW, counted once but in the wrong bucket. Loading one moves capacity from rooftop to wheeled: add it to by_source.private, subtract the same figure from FIXED.rooftopMW, in one commit.
